GHA.note: The notice names the platform as what the draft bill would anchor, and says nothing of it being built or in service.

facts.fact: NITA invited the public to comment on the draft NITA Data Harmonisation Bill 2025, posted on its website, from 19 to 27 November 2025, with responses sent by email.

GHA.note: The draft is a bill on data sharing and interoperability, which is the law study's; no framework is said to be written.

facts.fact: NITA put out for public consultation the draft Data Harmonisation Bill 2025, to set a legal framework for data sharing, standardisation and interoperability across public and private institutions through a National Data Exchange Platform.

GHA.note: Nothing stated on who builds or runs government systems.
Local assemblies are only named as invitees to comment; no connection is stated.

facts.fact: NITA invited ministries, assemblies, private sector, academia, civil society, development partners and the public to comment on the draft Data Harmonisation Bill 2025 from 19 to 27 November 2025.
